$comment: Slider — a value picked by dragging along a rail. The rail is the secondary paper fill, the travelled portion is the brand, and the knob is a card-weight disc with the sticker border, so the control reads as the same family as Button and Switch. The row is `size.control` tall regardless of how thin the rail is: the rail is the graphic, but the whole row is the target, which is what keeps a 12px rail comfortably grabbable.

height.comment: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

fill-bg.comment: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

thumb-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

gap.comment: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value
